description: This Java abstract class 'KeysToMultiValues' manages a multimap of key-value pairs with various methods for adding, removing, and retrieving entries, supporting flexible key and value types, and handling modifications. It is part of the 'org.mockserver.model' package, likely used for modeling key-to-multivalue mappings within the MockServer project.

classes.name: KeysToMultiValues
classes.description: An abstract class managing a multimap of key-value pairs with support for different key and value types, providing methods for modification, retrieval, and comparison.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a key-value entry from a key and collection of values.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Abstract method to mark the object as modified.

methods.name: getKeyMatchStyle
methods.description: Returns the current key match style.

methods.name: withKeyMatchStyle
methods.description: Sets the key match style and returns the object for chaining.

methods.name: withEntries
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add multiple entries from a map, list, or array.

methods.name: withEntry
methods.description: Adds a single entry by key and values.

methods.name: replaceEntry
methods.description: Replaces an existing entry with a new one.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all entries as a list.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves values associated with a key.

methods.name: getFirstValue
methods.description: Returns the first value for a given key.

methods.name: containsEntry
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists by key or key-value pair.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the multimap is empty.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Abstract method to clone the object.
